description: The Crucible's navigation, collision and fairness checks (ADR-040; World Validation Standard gates 6, 7 and 8), run by Game/Scripts/ValidateBattleground.ps1 on the generated map with the server's own walls (structures stand in their own navigation holes; the layout check places them). It also draws the navigation map. Routes are named by Team A's anchors; Team B walks each one's half-turn rotation, with the same navigation agent. Anchors: Fountain, PrimeWell, BaseTower.<index>, Spire.<lane>.<order> (0 outermost), Inhibitor.<lane>, Camp.<species>, FluxWell.<site>, Crossing.<lane> (where the lane runs deepest into the river). Tolerances are provisional review values (Battleground Bible §2 terrain fairness): a failure is a finding to fix in the layout or the generator, not a number to widen.
